items.title: Harold Ousley interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: Freddie Hubbard did it, George Benson did it. I was working with Ray Bryant at the time... so I wrote it for that particular recording. But Stanley Turrentine did it.

ctx.x: Yeah. Another iron in the fire.

Yeah, yeah. Now on “Return of the Prodigal Son” I had several recordings on. Freddie Hubbard did it, George Benson did it. I was working with Ray Bryant at the time at Minton’s as a matter of fact and he was getting ready to do some recordings so I wrote it for that particular recording. But Stanley Turrentine did it. So I had about seven or eight recordings on it.
Neat. And I see you have some cable T.V. ventures?
